name: JoAi: Studio Export

description.en: Export a composed studio project to a permanent shareable URL (video/clips MP4, or image/slideshow stills).
description.de: Exportiere ein fertiges Studio-Projekt zu einer dauerhaften, teilbaren URL (Video/Clips als MP4, oder Bild/Slideshow als Stills).
description.es: Export a composed studio project to a permanent shareable URL (video/clips MP4, or image/slideshow stills).
description.fr: Export a composed studio project to a permanent shareable URL (video/clips MP4, or image/slideshow stills).
description.ro: Export a composed studio project to a permanent shareable URL (video/clips MP4, or image/slideshow stills).
description.it: Export a composed studio project to a permanent shareable URL (video/clips MP4, or image/slideshow stills).

bot: Use this when the user wants to finalize and export a studio project. The project must be in 'composed' status. Returns the public export URL and asset download links (MP4 for video/clips, stills for image/slideshow).
